title: Leam
description: An autonomous agentic video generation and distribution platform that orchestrates LLMs, voice synthesis, programmatic rendering, and social APIs through an interactive real-time Flask and Socket.IO control dashboard.
Highlights: Autonomous agentic content generation pipeline orchestrating Gemini LLM, Google Cloud TTS (Chirp3-HD), and Faster-Whisper for automated scriptwriting and voiceover synthesis
Programmatic video rendering engine powered by Revideo, Puppeteer, and raw FFmpeg utilizing frame-by-frame image sequences for stutter-free animated visual overlays
Real-time web control dashboard built with Flask and Socket.IO featuring live hardware telemetry (CPU, RAM, GPU), log streaming, and dynamic module configuration
Hands-free social distribution pipeline automating YouTube Data API v3 OAuth2 workflows and Reddit content curation
Containerised deployment with Docker and Docker Compose configured with VAAPI hardware acceleration drivers for GPU-accelerated video rendering
